SHARE_POINT_LIST_SITES.instruction: List the SharePoint sites available. Use this first to discover which sites exist (e.g. the proposals/past-performance team sites) before browsing their contents. Use search='*' for all sites or a keyword to narrow.

SHARE_POINT_LIST_DRIVES_REST_API.instruction: List the document libraries (drives) inside a site. Pass site_name = the segment after /sites/ in the site URL (e.g. 'Servicesteam'). Use this to find where files live within a site.

SHARE_POINT_LIST_DRIVE_CHILDREN.instruction: List the folders and files inside a document library or folder. Pass drive_id (and folder_id to go deeper). Folders have a 'folder' facet; recurse into them by passing their id as folder_id. Use this to walk a library's structure.
SHARE_POINT_LIST_DRIVE_CHILDREN.usage: Browse folders and files in a library

SHARE_POINT_SEARCH_QUERY.instruction: Search SharePoint content with KQL (Keyword Query Language). Use to find documents by topic/keyword across a site quickly (e.g. 'capability statement cybersecurity', 'past performance Army'). Narrow with FileType, Author, or a site path to avoid noisy results.

SHARE_POINT_GET_SITE_DRIVE_ITEM_BY_PATH.instruction: Resolve a file or folder by its server-relative path (e.g. '/Shared Documents/Past Performance/Army-WIN-T.docx') to get its metadata + ids. Use to confirm a file exists and obtain drive_id/item_id or the server-relative URL before downloading.
SHARE_POINT_GET_SITE_DRIVE_ITEM_BY_PATH.usage: Resolve a SharePoint item by path

SHARE_POINT_DOWNLOAD_FILE_BY_SERVER_RELA.instruction: Download a file's content by its server-relative URL. Returns a hosted content link (s3url) to fetch the bytes. Use ONLY for the specific file you need (e.g. one past-performance write-up) to ground the email — never bulk-download.

SHARE_POINT_LIST_ALL_LISTS.instruction: List the SharePoint Lists in a site (structured-data tables — trackers, registers, opportunity logs). Pass site_name. Use to discover data lists that may hold relevant info (e.g. an opportunities or past-performance list).

SHARE_POINT_LIST_LIST_COLUMNS.instruction: Get the columns (schema) of a SharePoint List by its GUID. Use to understand what fields a list holds before reading its items.

SHARE_POINT_GET_LIST_ITEMS_BY_GUID.instruction: Read the items (rows) of a SharePoint List by its GUID. Use to pull the specific records you need (e.g. relevant past-performance entries) to ground the email — request a narrow set, not the whole list.
SHARE_POINT_GET_LIST_ITEMS_BY_GUID.usage: Read items from a SharePoint List
